subject: Re: 60k service for your Outback
body:
Hi Jamie,

Thanks for the details. For the 60,000-mile service on your 2019 Outback we'd do the oil change, tire rotation and brake inspection. The cabin air filter is optional, your call.

I have Saturday, October 17 at 8:45am open. If that works, grab it on our online booking page so it's in the system. Plan on about three hours. You're welcome to wait in our lounge, or we can run you home on the shuttle.

From your earlier note: mileage is 59,870 and the best number for you is (720) 555-0146.

Thanks,
Chris Delgado
Service Advisor, Summit Subaru
